name: VSP Vision Care (VSP Individual Vision Plans)
why: Rank 1: largest U.S. vision benefits company (~90M members); individual plans billed directly in the VSP member account.

name: EyeMed Vision Care (Individual & Family plans)
why: Rank 2: second-largest vision carrier (~60M members); individual plans billed through its administrator InsuranceTPA.

name: Delta Dental Insurance Company / Delta Dental of California
why: Rank 3: largest Delta Dental enterprise (~45M enrollees), individual premiums paid in its own online account.

name: MetLife Dental (TakeAlong Dental)
why: Rank 6: one of the largest dental carriers; TakeAlong Dental is its direct-billed individual product. Davis/Superior Vision (also MetLife) skipped as the same company.

name: Cigna Healthcare Dental (individual & family)
why: Rank 8: national carrier (~16M dental customers) with direct-billed individual dental plans.

name: Aetna Dental (Aetna Dental Direct)
why: Rank 10: CVS/Aetna national dental brand; Aetna Dental Direct member portal bills individual plans.

name: UnitedHealthcare Dental (UnitedHealthOne individual plans)
why: Rank 11: UnitedHealthcare national brand; individual dental and vision premiums share one billing site (UHC Member Hub), so UHC Vision (rank 7) is not picked separately.

name: Guardian Dental (Guardian Direct)
why: Rank 12: major national dental carrier (~9M members) selling direct individual dental plans.

name: Ameritas Dental, Vision & Hearing (individual plans)
why: Rank 17: well-known national direct seller of individual dental/vision/hearing plans with an online member account.

name: Humana Dental & Vision (individual plans)
why: Rank 18: national brand; individual dental/vision premiums paid in MyHumana or via Express Pay. DentaQuest (rank 4) skipped: members usually pay no premium.

name: United Concordia Dental
why: Highmark's national dental carrier (individual, DHMO, FEDVIP plans); invoiced members pay online in MyDentalBenefits.

name: Anthem Dental (Elevance Health)
why: Elevance/Anthem BCBS individual dental plans in 14 states; premiums paid via Quick Pay, member portal or Sydney Health app.

name: BENEFEDS (FEDVIP premium billing)
why: OPM's premium billing site for every FEDVIP dental/vision carrier (millions of federal enrollees); GEHA/FEP Dental/other FEDVIP carriers bill here, so they are not picked separately.

name: DeltaDentalCoversMe (Delta Dental individual & family)
why: Shared billing site for individual plans of ~15 Delta Dental companies (WA, IL, MA, VA, CO, NJ, WI...); picked once instead of each state company.

name: Mutual of Omaha (dental insurance)
why: Well-known national insurer; individual dental (140,000+ customers) paid in Customer Access.

name: Aspen Dental
why: Largest U.S. dental office brand (~1,100 offices); patient bills paid online in its PersonaPay billing site.

name: Pacific Dental Services (Smile Generation MyChart)
why: ~1,000 supported offices; bills viewed and paid in Smile Generation MyChart with guest pay.

name: Great Expressions Dental Centers
why: Large multi-state dental group; Bill Pay with myEasyMatch one-time payments and e-statements.

name: MyEyeDr.
why: Largest U.S. optometry chain (~900 offices); online card payments in its patient billing portal.

name: Western Dental & Orthodontics
why: Large CA/AZ/NV/TX dental chain (Sonrava); bills paid in its own PersonaPay site.
